summary.headline: Prosperity and Adversity of the Native
summary.text: The concluding rules for royal status examine triplicity lords, planetary diurnal and nocturnal leadership, oriental and occidental positions, exaltations, houses, and angular mutual aspects. Chapter VII begins its treatment of the native’s prosperity and substance, judging them from the triplicity lords of the time-lord luminary, especially their angularity, freedom from malefics, and position within the first fifteen degrees of a sign.
